programs.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programs.desc: Pop the kettle on! Adam and two brilliant bakers, pastry chef Gareth Whitton and bestselling author Helen Goh are making some quicky biccies tonight.

programs.title: Cheese Slices
programs.desc: The Poitou region is the original home of many of the famous goat cheeses of France, Will Studd journeys to the village of Sainte-Maure de Touraine to attend the annual Goats Cheese fair. In the Judge's Hall he finds out what to look for in a perfect chevre, as well as witnessing an unusual inthronisation ceremony.

programs.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programs.desc: Trish McKenzie shares her recipe for snack pops and Justine makes pork rack with blackberry sauce and poached Eggs with a delicious red wine sauce!

programs.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize
programs.desc: Adam Liaw explores the amazing and unique culinary culture of Japan. This week, Adam uncovers the secrets to superb sake, samples some of the world's best sushi and prepares a classic Japanese dish with his mother-in-law.

programs.title: Ainsley's Great Garden Cook Off
programs.desc: Ainsley is joined by chefs Ben Ebbrell and Cyrus Todiwala in the kitchen garden of Blicking Hall in Norfolk for a light-hearted cooking contest.

programs.title: Bring A Plate
programs.sub_title: Jc's Chicken And Pork Adobo With Eggs
programs.desc: JC serves up his Filipino national dish sharing a touching tale of his Lola grandmother's culinary influence. Hear how he uses the DISH structure to help him talk about the food.
